description: This Java class 'RetrieveAllNonClosedLoanIdServiceImpl' implements the 'RetrieveLoanIdService' interface and provides methods to retrieve loan IDs and related data for non-closed loans within the Fineract platform. It contains logic for querying loans based on status and business date, partitioning result sets, and fetching loan details behind specific dates or locks.

classes.name: RetrieveAllNonClosedLoanIdServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a service to retrieve non-closed loan IDs and related COB (Close of Business) data, used within the loan management and COB processing components of Fineract.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCOBPartitions
methods.description: Constructs and executes a SQL query to partition loans based on ID ranges, status, and business date, returning a list of COBPartition objects.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsBehindDate
methods.description: Retrieves loans behind a specified business date filtered by loan IDs and statuses.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsBehindDateOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves loans behind a specified business date or null last closed date, filtered by loan IDs and statuses.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsOldestCobProcessed
methods.description: Gets the oldest COB processed loans for a given business date, filtered by statuses.

methods.name: retrieveAllNonClosedLoansByLastClosedBusinessDateAndMinAndMaxLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves all non-closed loans within specified ID ranges and last closed business date, considering catch-up mode and statuses.

methods.name: findAllStayedLockedByCobBusinessDate
methods.description: Finds all loans that have remained locked on a given COB business date.
